items.title: 巴西｜DP World 桑托斯港扩建进入设备交付阶段
items.title_en: Brazil | DP World Santos expansion reaches crane delivery milestone
items.summary: DP World宣布桑托斯港扩建项目已收到8台全电动起重机，包括2台岸桥及6台轮胎式龙门吊；投资约3.1亿美元，计划于2026年底将年集装箱处理能力提升至170万TEU。
items.summary_en: DP World has received eight fully electric cranes—two quay cranes and six RTGs—as part of its approximately US$310 million Santos terminal expansion, targeting 1.7 million TEU annual capacity by end-2026.
items.why_it_matters: 设备已交付，项目处于实际实施阶段，港口工程和物流配套需求具备明确商业基础。
items.why_it_matters_en: Equipment delivery confirms active implementation and a tangible pipeline for port and logistics support services.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注港口配套工程、仓储物流设备、工业电气、设备维护及相关供应链。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track port enabling works, warehousing equipment, industrial electrical systems and maintenance supply chains.

items.title: 肯尼亚｜Dangote 拉穆大型炼油项目推进工程管理合作
items.title_en: Kenya | Dangote Lamu refinery advances through PMC-EPCM engagement
items.summary: Dangote位于肯尼亚拉穆的拟建炼油及石化项目规划原油加工能力70万桶/日；Engineers India Ltd.承担工程管理及EPCM顾问工作，相关合同价值超过4.5亿美元。
items.summary_en: Dangote's proposed Lamu refinery and petrochemical complex has a planned 700,000 bpd capacity. Engineers India Ltd. has been engaged for PMC-EPCM services under a contract exceeding US$450 million.
items.why_it_matters: 大型能源项目推进工程管理与实施安排，后续土建、机电、设备及劳务市场值得跟踪，但具体分包机会尚待确认。
items.why_it_matters_en: Progress in engineering management may lead to future civil, mechanical, electrical and workforce opportunities, subject to procurement confirmation.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注施工分包、设备和材料、管道电气安装及技能工人供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track subcontracting, machinery and materials, piping/electrical installation and skilled workforce.

items.title: 阿曼｜超过5.5亿里亚尔的城市与旅游开发协议
items.title_en: Oman | Urban October agreements exceed OMR550 million
items.summary: 2026年阿曼Urban October活动期间签署涉及旅游、教育、房地产及土地使用等领域的协议和项目，公布的投资总额超过5.5亿阿曼里亚尔。
items.summary_en: Agreements and projects announced during Oman's Urban October 2026 event surpassed OMR550 million, covering tourism, education, property and land-use development.
items.why_it_matters: 城市建设和旅游开发协议可能带动酒店、装修、建材及机电需求，但不同项目尚需分别确认进度和采购安排。
items.why_it_matters_en: Urban and tourism development could support downstream fit-out, materials and MEP demand, pending individual project and procurement confirmation.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注酒店装修与家具、建材供应、机电设备及当地施工合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track hotel fit-out and furniture, building materials, MEP supply and local construction partnerships.

items.title: 阿尔及利亚｜两座100MW风电场公开招标
items.title_en: Algeria | Two 100MW wind farms out to tender
items.summary: 阿尔及利亚公布两座风电场的建设招标，分别为Laghouat省Tilghemt和Djelfa地区各100MW，合计200MW；范围涉及设计、土建、供货、运输、安装和调试，投标截止2026年11月25日。
items.summary_en: Algeria has tendered two 100MW wind farms, in Tilghemt (Laghouat) and Djelfa, totaling 200MW. Scope includes engineering, civil works, supply, transport, erection and commissioning. Bids are due 25 November 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 公开招标有明确工程范围及截止时间，适合EPC和风电设备供应商评估参与条件。
items.why_it_matters_en: A dated public tender with defined scope provides a specific entry point for EPC firms and wind-equipment suppliers.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注风电设备、EPC总包、土建安装及当地合作伙伴。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track wind-turbine supply, EPC, civil installation and local partners.

items.title: 尼日利亚｜建筑及灌溉工程出现公开招标线索
items.title_en: Nigeria | Construction and irrigation procurement notices emerge
items.summary: 2026年10月8日至10日尼日利亚招标信息包括Delta州建设工程，以及Kano州Jakara–Wasai灌溉工程设计复核和施工监理咨询意向征集；其中Kano项目列明2026年10月22日截止。
items.summary_en: October procurement notices include construction works in Delta State and an EOI for design review and construction supervision of Kano State's Jakara–Wasai irrigation scheme; the Kano EOI closes 22 October 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 具体采购公告可作为工程承包及咨询服务的开发入口，但施工包与咨询包应分别核对资格要求。
items.why_it_matters_en: Specific procurement notices offer entry points for contractors and consultants, subject to separate eligibility checks.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注建筑工程承包、水利灌溉服务、工程咨询及设备材料供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track civil works, irrigation, engineering consultancy and materials/equipment supply.

items.title: 西班牙／拉美｜伊比利亚美洲推动港口与多式联运合作
items.title_en: Spain / Latin America | Ibero-American transport and port cooperation advances
items.summary: 2026年10月9日西班牙巴利亚多利德举行的伊比利亚美洲交通与基础设施部长会议通过《巴利亚多利德宣言》，并同意推动设立伊比利亚美洲港口论坛，以加强运输基础设施及港口合作。
items.summary_en: At the 9 October 2026 Ibero-American Transport and Infrastructure Ministers' Conference in Valladolid, delegates adopted the Valladolid Declaration and agreed to establish an Ibero-American Port Forum to strengthen cooperation.
items.why_it_matters: 属于区域政策与合作框架，尚非具体工程招标；可提前布局港口物流网络与跨境合作伙伴。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a regional policy framework rather than a project tender, but may create longer-term channels for port and logistics partnerships.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注港口基础设施、多式联运物流、港口服务与跨境商业合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track port infrastructure, multimodal logistics, port services and cross-border partnerships.
